column1: # Behavioral sdd.design gate bench fixtures — one row per elicitation and gate-state rule of skills/_shared/tracks/sdd.md.
# Columns (tab-separated): id, situation (request, grounding, and recorded interview state), expected (key=value pairs joined by ';').
# Keys: skip, resume (a gate id or none), questions (a number or >0), gate (open|advance|skipped), assumptions, persist. A row pins only the keys it names.

# Sensitivity, 2026-10-08 (last 4 rows, rules removed from a contract copy): proceed-anyway fails without the proceed-anyway delegation rule; spent-budget-resume, assumption-not-delegated, and route-mid-block pass without their rules and guard behavior the model already shows.
